blocks.text:
1. Derive the PROJECTION_TYPE using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection' and pass the Column_Value_Two_Txt as column value.
2. Derive th SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection', Column_Value_Two_Txt='WIP_Projection' and pass the Column_Value_Three_Txt as column value.
3. For defining SCHEDULE_DATE
Fetch the CALENDAR_DT as per below logic from V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR by mapping the FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR and DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR with SCHEDULE_DATE -
If BATCH_IND = 'SHIFT1'/'SHIFT2 then by mapping the COLUMN_VALUE_ELEVEN_TXT as Current_Date() where  Business_Rule_Nm ='FinanceCalendar',  Entity_Nm ='Calendar', Subject_Area_Nm ='FSCO_Cal' and  COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT ='Saturday'. 
IF BATCH_IND = 'WEEK' then Saturday of the work week by mapping the COLUMN_VALUE_TWELVE_TXT in metadata where  and Business_Rule_Nm ='FinanceCalendar',  Entity_Nm ='Calendar', Subject_Area_Nm ='FSCO_Cal' and  COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT ='Saturday'. 
4. For defining PRODUCTION_ID we need below column from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT
4.1. LOCATION_ID
4.2. FISCAL_YEAR_NBR||WORK_WEEK_NM  - Join FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT with FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR
from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR to get FISCAL_YEAR_NBR and WORK_WEEK_NM
4.3. DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR (Monday = 2) - Join FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR, WORK_WEEK_NM and DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NM from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT with FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR, WORK_WEEK_NM and DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NM
from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR to get DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR
4.4. BATCH_IND - If BATCH_IND = SHIFT1 then 'D' and if BATCH_IND = SHIFT2 then 'N' and BATCH_IND = WEEK then 'W'
4.5. PUBLISHEDDATE - only Time - to get the time extract the time part from PUBLISHEDDATE in HHMMSS format
Now combine the above fields in below format
<LOCATION_ID>_<FISCAL_YEAR_NBR||WORK_WEEK_NM>.<DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NBR><SHIFTNO><PUBLISHEDDATE(HHMMSS)> (1011_2024WW48.2N043134)
5. OPERATION_NBR = MES_OPERATION to be converted to OPERATION_NBR (Jyoti to help with conversion). For now default it to "10"
6. Define LOCATION_ID = MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD
7. Bring rest of the column as its from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_STAGE.
statements: 1. Derive the PROJECTION_TYPE using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection' and pass the Column_Value_Two_Txt as column value.

2. Derive th SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection', Column_Value_Two_Txt='WIP_Projection' and pass the Column_Value_Three_Txt as column value.

3. For defining SCHEDULE_DATE Fetch the CALENDAR_DT as per below logic from V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR by mapping the FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR and DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR with SCHEDULE_DATE - If BATCH_IND = 'SHIFT1'/'SHIFT2 then by mapping the COLUMN_VALUE_ELEVEN_TXT as Current_Date() where  Business_Rule_Nm ='FinanceCalendar',  Entity_Nm ='Calendar', Subject_Area_Nm ='FSCO_Cal' and  COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT ='Saturday'. IF BATCH_IND = 'WEEK' then Saturday of the work week by mapping the COLUMN_VALUE_TWELVE_TXT in metadata where  and Business_Rule_Nm ='FinanceCalendar',  Entity_Nm ='Calendar', Subject_Area_Nm ='FSCO_Cal' and  COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT ='Saturday'.
4. For defining PRODUCTION_ID we need below column from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT
4.1. LOCATION_ID

4.2. FISCAL_YEAR_NBR||WORK_WEEK_NM  - Join FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT with FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR to get FISCAL_YEAR_NBR and WORK_WEEK_NM

4.3. DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR (Monday = 2) - Join FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR, WORK_WEEK_NM and DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NM from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT with FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR, WORK_WEEK_NM and DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NM from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR to get DAY_OF_WEEK_NBR
4.4. BATCH_IND - If BATCH_IND = SHIFT1 then 'D' and if BATCH_IND = SHIFT2 then 'N' and BATCH_IND = WEEK then 'W'

4.5. PUBLISHEDDATE - only Time - to get the time extract the time part from PUBLISHEDDATE in HHMMSS format Now combine the above fields in below format <LOCATION_ID>_<FISCAL_YEAR_NBR||WORK_WEEK_NM>.<DAY_OF_WORK_WEEK_NBR><SHIFTNO><PUBLISHEDDATE(HHMMSS)> (1011_2024WW48.2N043134)
5. OPERATION_NBR = MES_OPERATION to be converted to OPERATION_NBR (Jyoti to help with conversion). For now default it to "10"
6. Define LOCATION_ID = MANUFACTURING_LOCATION_CD
7. Bring rest of the column as its from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_ROOT to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_WIP_PROJECTION_STAGE.

1. Derive the 'PROJECTION_TYPE' using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection_PDH' and pass the Column_Value_Two_Txt as column value.
2. Derive the 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM' using metadata where Subject_Area_Nm='FSCO_Sch', Entity_Nm='Schedule', Business_Rule_Nm='Schedule_Config', Column_Value_One_Txt='WIP_Projection_PDH', Column_Value_Two_Txt='WIP Projection' and pass the Column_Value_Three_Txt as column value.
3. Join the ITEM_ID, LOCATION_ID and SCHEDULE_DATE ( convert it to FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR using calander ) column in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_BALANCE_WAFER_STARTS_STAGE with ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD and FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR  column in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_PV_OPR_WORKWEEK_CORE_PIT and bring the relevant items to this core view.
4. For defining PROJECTED_QTY:
To calculate the 'PROJECTED_QTY' for the respective item, get the PARAMETER_QTY from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_PV_OPR_WORKWEEK_CORE_PIT where PARAMETER_NM = COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='FSCO_Prm' and ENTITY_NM='Parameter' and BUSINESS_RULE_NM='Parameter_Config' and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='YIELD_Parameter' by mapping the 'ITEM_ID' and 'LOCATION_ID' form IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_BALANCE_WAFER_STARTS_STAGE with the Parameter view. Then calculate the percentage of the QTY with the PARAMETER_QTY value. 
i.e., (QTY * PARAMETER_QTY)/100
5. For defining 'PROJECTED_SCHEDULE_DATE' - Join the FISCAL_YEAR_WORK_WEEK_NBR of V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_PV_OPR_WORKWEEK_CORE_PIT with V_CRR_FINANCE_CALENDAR to fetch the CALENDAR_DT. 
Then, add the PARAMETER_QTY (which is in days) to the calander date of the current WW. Fetch the PARAMETER_QTY value from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_PV_OPR_WORKWEEK_CORE_PIT where PARAMETER_NM = COLUMN_VALUE_TWO_TXT from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_CRR_BUSINESS_RULE_METADATA_DETAIL_CORE_PIT where SUBJECT_AREA_NM='FSCO_Prm' and ENTITY_NM='Parameter' and BUSINESS_RULE_NM='Parameter_Config' and COLUMN_VALUE_ONE_TXT='TPT_Parameter', by mapping the ITEM_ID and LOCATION_ID form IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_BALANCE_WAFER_STARTS_STAGE with the Parameter view. 
(Eg: If the calander date is 04-11-2025, then add 5 days to it, which will result in 09-11-2025)
6. Bring rest of the column as its from IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_BALANCE_WAFER_STARTS_STAGE to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_INV_FSCO_BALANCE_OUT_STAGE.
